data.one_liner: An advanced avatar widget with support for initials, images, status badges, and animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable avatar widget for Flutter applications. It supports features like automatic initials generation from names, status indicators, decorations, animations via AnimatedContainer, and child widgets.
use_when: You need to display user profiles or avatars with initials and status indicators.
You want customizable borders, shapes, and animations for your avatars.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete UI component kit rather than a single-purpose widget.
strengths: Rich customization API including name initials generation, status colors, and decorations.
Supports animation out of the box using AnimatedContainer.
weaknesses: No documentation on some properties like gesture detection in the provided text.
data.minimal_example:
AdvancedAvatar(
  name: 'John Doe',
  size: 60,
  statusColor: Colors.green,
  image: NetworkImage('https://example.com/avatar.png'),
)
